# Popular Jana Neethi Medicals & Surgicals

> Popular Jana Neethi Medicals & Surgicals is a healthcare pharmacy and surgical supply network in Perinthalmanna and Angadippuram (Malappuram, Kerala) providing prescription & Pradhan Mantri Jan Aushadhi generic medicines, surgical supplies, medical equipment, easy EMI equipment financing, home-care medical equipment rentals, and doorstep medicine delivery via WhatsApp.

## Core Pages & Services
- [Home & Complete Healthcare Overview](https://www.populardrugs.in/): Official website for Popular Jana Neethi Medicals & Surgicals.
- [Medical Equipment Rental in Perinthalmanna](https://www.populardrugs.in/equipment-rental.html): Affordable daily, weekly, and monthly rentals of sanitized Fowler/Semi-Fowler hospital beds, wheelchairs, 5L/10L oxygen concentrators, BiPAP/CPAP units, and air mattresses.
- [Buy Medical Equipment on EMI](https://www.populardrugs.in/emi-medical-equipment.html): Easy monthly installment (EMI) plans for oxygen concentrators, CPAP/BiPAP machines, patient monitors, and motorized hospital beds.
- [Jan Aushadhi Kendra & Prescription Medicines](https://www.populardrugs.in/jan-aushadhi-medicines.html): Genuine prescription medications, chronic-care refills, affordable Pradhan Mantri Jan Aushadhi generic medicines, and WhatsApp doorstep delivery.
- [Surgical Products & Hospital Supplies](https://www.populardrugs.in/surgical-supplies.html): Stainless steel surgical instruments, sterile gauze, bandages, medical gloves, IV sets, catheters, orthopedic supports, and clinic consumables.
- [Our 4 Store Locations & Hours](https://www.populardrugs.in/stores.html): Exact addresses, phone numbers, opening hours, and directions for all branches in Perinthalmanna and Angadippuram.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.populardrugs.in/#faq): Direct answers on store locations, rentals, EMI options, home delivery, and opening hours.
